metadata.description: Claude Code plugins that make it trustworthy where it usually isn't: research checked against its sources, secrets Claude never sees, and new projects built to a plan.

plugins.name: recursive-research
plugins.description: Deep research you can check: Claude researches a subject in stages you approve and leaves a source-tagged knowledge base, with its strongest claims verified word for word against their sources by a script.

plugins.name: secret-courier
plugins.description: Let Claude use your API keys, tokens and passwords without ever seeing them: values stay encrypted on your machine, Claude works by name, and fail-closed guard hooks keep its tools away from secret files. Windows only.

plugins.name: project-scaffolder
plugins.description: Start new projects with a plan instead of improvising: a short interview, parallel research and a design you approve, then a scaffolded project with conventions, a .env guard and a v1 build plan Claude follows.
